Provider: Fondazione per la Casa dell'Accademia

Submission deadline: 30 June 2025

The Fondazione per la Casa dell’Accademia offers several scholarships of the value of CHF 3,150 each for students living in the German or French-speaking cantons, corresponding to half of the rent for a room at the student housing.

• Bachelor in Architettura
  • Master in Architecture
  • Master in Storia e teoria dell’arte e dell’architettura 120
  • Master in Storia e teoria dell’arte e dell’architettura 90
